summary: Fail-closed REST dispatch for OpenAPI-declared contract-only routes in messenger, mail, social, and community REST crates.
claim_boundary: Contract-only dispatch guard only. This adds explicit 501 handling for unimplemented OpenAPI routes; it does not implement broader business handlers, AsyncAPI/proto parity handlers, persistence, runtime gateway binding, or production endpoint readiness.

facets.F1_simplicity: Each REST crate has a tiny dispatcher over its existing route catalog; no framework, async runtime, or gateway dependency was introduced.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: Honest non-claim: fail-closed dispatch avoids false-green route availability but does not satisfy full hyperscaler route/runtime/SLO/deployment readiness.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests verify known contract-only routes return 501, implemented typed routes are refused by this dispatcher, and unknown routes are distinct errors.
facets.F5_quality: cargo test, clippy -D warnings, cargo fmt --check, dependency-seam, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this evidence run.
facets.F7_security_privacy: Implemented write routes cannot bypass existing typed API/usecase policy seams through the generic contract-only dispatcher.
facets.F11_observability: The 501 response reason is explicit for future gateway telemetry and SLO exclusion; no runtime emission claim.
